title.narrative: Public Expenditure Management and Procurement Capacity Building Project

description.narrative: The purpose of the Grant is to improve budget execution in line agencies and improve outcomes from public expenditure by focusing on two key areas: a) understanding of budget management and execution procedures; and b) procurement procedures and good practice. Specific activities financed by the Grant are: a) review and consolidation of public expenditure management and procurement manuals, guidance and other related documentation; b) development of public expenditure management and procurement capacity building materials; and c) implementation of a train the trainer program. Expected outcomes from implementation of the Grant include: improved budget execution rates; improvements in service delivery performance; improved compliance with procedures; and closer alignment between budgets, plans and actual expenditure outcomes. The Grant supports capacity building needs identified in the Public Expenditure Management Note, the Country Procurement Assessment and in the Second Transition Support Program. The obiejctive of this Grant is to assist the Recipient in strengthening its budget execution in line ministries and improving the outcomes from public expenditure by focusing on: (i) understanding the budget management and execution procedures; and (ii) setting procurement procedures and good practices in place.
